author: sjm41
body:
* **ARBA rule (ID and label):**
ARBA00022438

* **Sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**
Dmel S-Lap1 (FBgn0035915) (Q9VSM6)

* **Description of issue**
ARBA00022438 -> keyword #Aminopeptidase (KW-0031) -> aminopeptidase activity (GO:0004177)

ARBA00022438 adds this based on presence of these 2 InterPro signatures on Q9VSM6:
[IPR000819](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/interpro/entry/IPR000819) Peptidase M17, leucyl aminopeptidase, C-terminal
[IPR011356](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/interpro/entry/IPR011356) Peptidase M17, leucine aminopeptidase/peptidase B

however, S-Lap1 is characterised as lacking catalytic activity ([30802236](http://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmed/30802236/) and has a "NOT enables [metalloaminopeptidase activity](https://flybase.org/reports/GO:0070006)" annotations from that paper.
title: ARBA2GO issue: ARBA00022438

author: Antonialock
body: Thanks. This should be filtered once we implement the "NOT" post-processing step, however ARBA also adds a lot of inaccurate swiss-prot curation (names, rhea reactions etc) so I have curated all the S-lap entries (1-8). Since it is so many entries (above ARBA min support of 5) I will also do granny-smith so that ARBA doesn't start propagating annotations from these proteins to other Peptidase M17 proteins.
